description: Normalized requirements from free-form, ticket, notes pack, or greenfield input. Produced by requirements-intake. Does not carry FTS/design backlinks — those appear only after fit-to-standard / solution-design / backlog-drafting.

requirements_id.description: Stable ID assigned at creation, e.g. REQ-2026-08-11-credit-dual-approval.

source.description: free-form | story:<path> | ticket:<id> | ticket-unresolved:<id> | notes-pack | greenfield

original_input.description: Verbatim ask or pointer; do not rewrite away the user's words.

acceptance_criteria.description: Only criteria present in the source. Empty array means none in source — open_questions must explain.

open_questions.description: Required. Use an explicit empty list only when truly none; prefer at least documenting unknowns for thin inputs.
